general._comment_latch_up_detect: 1: enable the board latch-up detection. A run with it enabled leaves the boards in a bad state (all-hit / no-hit) until power cycled, so keep it 0.

MADALM_0._comment: Adalm for DAQ enable (DIO_mask: bit i = Di; D0-D4).

MADALM_1._comment: Counter reset on the same Adalm as MADALM_0 (DIO_mask: D8-D11).

MADALM_2._comment: Software veto to the scaler (active high, DIO_mask: D12). Same Adalm as MADALM_0.

SCI._comment: SCI mode (mada.py --sci): another ADALM than MADALM_n records the PMT pulses against the DAQ trigger (NIM, 50 ohm terminated). channels: 1 or 2 of the analog inputs. pre_trigger_samples: at most 8192 (10 ns each).

SCALER._comment: Scaler (runScaler on the Zybo, started over ssh once per period while DAQ enable is low). output_root is this PC's path of the directory shared with the Zybo (remote_output_root: the Zybo's path of it); it holds <run>/perNNNN. Run 'ssh <host>' once by hand first so the host key is known.
